assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying rhythm disturbances and to guide further management.
This service is medically necessary to evaluate the documented arrhythmia (diagnosis codes R55,I48.91,I49.9) causing the recurrent syncope and presyncope.
We respectfully request that the denial code CO-22 be reversed on the basis of this clinical indication.
